tools.name: check_package
tools.description: Vet a package for typosquats, known-malware, hallucinated names, and supply-chain risk BEFORE installing it. Returns SAFE, WARN, or BLOCK with reasons. Call this before running any package install. Set deep=true to also download the artifact and statically analyze install/build scripts (slower).

deep.description: download the artifact and statically analyze install/build scripts (slower)

version.description: optional; defaults to the latest published version

tools.name: scan_agents
tools.description: Audit a directory for AI agent security risks: prompt injection in CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/GEMINI.md, malicious or unencrypted MCP server URLs, excessive permissions in settings.json, and supply-chain risks from unpinned npx MCP packages. Call this before running an agent in an unfamiliar repo, or in CI to gate agent config changes.

dir.description: directory to scan (default: current working directory)
